callTemplates.summary: Agent verifies caller identity, confirms balance, and aligns on a deferred payment plan.
Caller disputes repeated attempts, agent apologizes and provides compliance disclosure.
Customer negotiates a split payment and agent outlines schedule and disclosures.
Call transferred to supervisor after heated tone, risk flags recorded.

transcriptPrompts: Thanks for calling Atlas Recoveries, this is {agent}, can I start with your full name?
Per the FDCPA I need to disclose this is an attempt to collect a debt, and any information will be used for that purpose.
I can definitely review payment options with you today.
It looks like we received two payments last month totaling ${amount}.
Would a bi-weekly plan on Fridays work better?
I'll email the full outline to the address ending in {emailSuffix}.
I hear the frustration—let me slow down and walk through the timeline.
Please avoid sharing banking info aloud if you're not in a private space.
I'll stay on the line while you review the verification code.
Is there anything else I can clarify about fees or due dates?
